name: Terminal strip assembly
summary: A physical assembly of identified terminals and the selected connecting accessories.
description: A terminal strip assembles connection points and accessories into an identified physical arrangement. Its schedule connects terminals to conductors, field devices and equipment. Additional links, disconnect facilities or test accessories change the assembly scope.
readingNotes: Match physical terminal order to the terminal schedule.
Identify accessories and special-function terminals separately.
drawingChecklist: Reference the terminal products and accessories.
Link the schematic and wiring schedule.
distinction: A terminal connection symbol is an electrical reference; a terminal strip is a physical assembly with a documented arrangement.
